headline: Sudden Flares in Olavis Wake and Pari Peak Intensify Contested Fronts
war_summary: Over the past three hours, explosive combat erupted across previously subdued sectors, with Olavis Wake and Pari Peak suddenly plunged into violent contention. Olavis Wake absorbed eight rapid base transfers within two hours as fighting flared around Iltaku and Kulkue amid steep losses on both sides, while Pari Peak recorded six base shifts focused at Pariah and Itään. Meanwhile, The Gutter remained a volatile cauldron, producing seven additional base exchanges across Kuoppa and The Parras. Across the frozen fields of Weathered Expanse, relentless skirmishing yielded six further flag turnovers at Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest as combined casualties exceeded three thousand in two hours. Stlican Shelf sustained renewed friction with two flips at Breaker Town, and Marban Hollow logged sporadic movement near Oster Wall. In contrast, earlier frontline shifts in Nevish Line, Linn of Mercy, and Farranac Coast paused, though Farranac Coast and Callahan's Passage continued to endure heavy casualties without yielding new territorial transfers.
